notes: Pencil 19. The opening completes the previous page. The author replaces “doit être” by “est” and proposes a functor on Teichmüller groupoids obtained by filling an indexed selection I of punctures, changing type (g,nu) to (g,nu-nu-prime). He expects transitivity for successive fillings, but still finds it hard to incorporate inclusion morphisms into the larger Galois–Teichmüller category. The text explicitly contrasts “catégorie (pas groupoïde !)”. The adjective is the masculine plural évidents; the noun ending propriété(s) remains visually uncertain and is not repaired to fit it. If the target is required to remain within the anabelian objects discussed earlier, an additional restriction on the remaining punctures is needed: filling all three punctures of a genus-zero three-punctured curve gives the complete genus-zero curve. The present sentence does not state that restriction. The final À moins d’y continues on scan 021.

checks.statement: Successive fillings of disjoint labelled puncture subsets have the same final puncture set as filling their union.
checks.outcome: The remaining set is (P minus I) minus J = P minus (I union J); the total cardinality drop is additive. This checks the set operation, not all categorical descent assertions.
